description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for Linux audit daemon records relayed as one audit record per line, with fixture-backed routing for SYSCALL, EXECVE, USER_LOGIN, PATH, CWD, USER_AUTH, CONFIG_CHANGE, AVC, DAEMON_START, DAEMON_END, DAEMON_CONFIG, USER_CMD, TTY, and SOFTWARE_UPDATE records.

event_families.label: Linux audit current working directory records

normalized_fields.audit_type: Linux audit record type such as SYSCALL, EXECVE, USER_LOGIN, or PATH
normalized_fields.audit_serial: Audit event serial used to correlate multi-record audit events
normalized_fields.action: Derived from audit record type or operation
normalized_fields.signature: Audit record type, operation, or audit key
normalized_fields.syscall: Linux syscall number from SYSCALL records
normalized_fields.process_path: exe or a0 process path where present
normalized_fields.process_command_line: Derived EXECVE command line from fixture arguments
normalized_fields.src: Alias for src_ip where login records include addr
normalized_fields.operation: Audit operation token such as PAM:authentication or add_rule
normalized_fields.cwd: Current working directory from CWD records
normalized_fields.src_host: Source hostname token where authentication records include it
normalized_fields.audit_rule_list: Audit rule list such as exit from CONFIG_CHANGE records
normalized_fields.selinux_permission: SELinux AVC permission token such as write
normalized_fields.selinux_source_context: SELinux source security context from AVC records
normalized_fields.selinux_target_context: SELinux target security context from AVC records
normalized_fields.selinux_target_class: SELinux target class from AVC records
normalized_fields.daemon_version: auditd userspace daemon version from DAEMON_START records
normalized_fields.kernel_version: Kernel version token from DAEMON_START records
normalized_fields.audit_format: Audit output format token from DAEMON_START records
normalized_fields.user_command_cwd: Working directory captured in USER_CMD records
normalized_fields.user_command_hex: Hex-encoded command payload from USER_CMD records; retained without decoding/redaction by this pack
normalized_fields.tty_major: TTY major number from TTY audit records
normalized_fields.tty_minor: TTY minor number from TTY audit records
normalized_fields.tty_data_hex: Hex-encoded terminal/keystroke data from TTY records; sensitive and retained only as source evidence
normalized_fields.software_type: Software package type such as rpm where present
normalized_fields.gpg_result: GPG verification result token from SOFTWARE_UPDATE records
normalized_fields.key_enforce: Package key-enforcement flag from SOFTWARE_UPDATE records
normalized_fields.root_dir: Package manager root directory from SOFTWARE_UPDATE records
normalized_fields.daemon_operation: Audit daemon operation token from DAEMON_END/DAEMON_CONFIG records such as terminate or reconfigure
normalized_fields.daemon_state: Audit daemon configuration state token where present, such as no-change
normalized_fields.session_id: Linux audit session ID where daemon lifecycle rows include ses
normalized_fields.security_subject: SELinux/security subject token from daemon lifecycle/configuration records

data_structures: Linux audit current working directory records

explicit_gaps: live Linux auditd source-version emission and kernel/userspace option behavior are not proven by this harness
multi-record audit-event correlation is preserved by audit_serial but not assembled into one event
AppArmor denials, audit daemon abort/rotate/resume, backlog/lost-event health records, distro wrappers, and collector envelopes remain deferred

requires_source_timezone_when_fields_mis: syslog envelope timezone or receiver time policy
timestamp_policy.notes: Fixtures use Linux audit epoch timestamps. Production relays should preserve msg=audit() timestamp and audit serial.

field_delimiting.quote_character: double quote for string values; USER_LOGIN msg field uses single quotes around nested content
field_delimiting.escape_policy: Synthetic values avoid secrets and use RFC5737 documentation addresses
field_delimiting.notes: Each line is one audit record. Multi-record audit events are correlated by audit_serial rather than assembled by this pack.

source.reference: Public Linux auditd/auditctl documentation and Elastic/Filebeat auditd module documentation; synthetic-equivalent fixtures authored from documented audit record structure.
source.notes: Fixtures use generic usernames, generic Linux paths, and RFC5737 documentation IP addresses; no customer Linux audit records or proprietary TA content are included.

curation.notes: 2026-06-18 hardening added Linux audit-userspace auditd source-template grounded DAEMON_END and DAEMON_CONFIG coverage while keeping conservative trust.

user.notes: Numeric Linux/audit user IDs are preserved; no UID-to-name lookup is performed.

action.notes: Derived from audit record type or operation; not a complete normalized action taxonomy.

signature_id.notes: Audit record type used as signature_id.

process_command_line.notes: Fixture-backed EXECVE arguments; retained by default.

cwd.notes: Current working directory from CWD records; used for audit correlation context.

audit_rule_list.notes: Audit rule list/configuration context from CONFIG_CHANGE records.

selinux_context.notes: SELinux source/target contexts and target class for AVC denial triage.

daemon_version.notes: Audit daemon lifecycle context for start records; not full auditd health monitoring.

command.notes: USER_CMD command payload is retained as hex source evidence; no command decoding or normalization is published.

tty_data.notes: TTY audit payload and terminal identifiers are sensitive source evidence, not decoded session reconstruction.

software_package.notes: Package update context from SOFTWARE_UPDATE records; not complete software inventory.

daemon_lifecycle.notes: Audit daemon shutdown/reconfiguration lifecycle context; not complete auditd health monitoring.

cim.notes: Partial Endpoint/Authentication/Change mapping only; not a complete Linux TA or auditd correlation implementation.

actor.user.uid.notes: Numeric IDs only; no user-name enrichment.

metadata.uid.notes: Audit serial for record correlation, not a globally unique event ID.

process.cwd.notes: CWD record context only; not assembled with all related records by the pack.

policy.rule.name.notes: Audit rule key/list context for configuration changes.

finding.title.notes: SELinux AVC denial context; not complete OCSF findings classification.

device.os.version.notes: Kernel version context from DAEMON_START records only.

metadata.product.version.notes: auditd version from DAEMON_START records only.

process.cmd_line.notes: USER_CMD command payload remains hex-encoded source evidence.

session.terminal.notes: TTY audit data retained for terminal activity review; no decoded keystroke reconstruction is published.

package.name.notes: Software update package context where auditd emits SOFTWARE_UPDATE records.

service.status.notes: Audit daemon lifecycle/configuration state helper mapping only.

ocsf.notes: OCSF mapping is helper guidance only.

event.action.notes: Derived from audit record type or operation.

event.id.notes: Audit serial, scoped to audit stream correlation.

service.version.notes: auditd daemon version from DAEMON_START records.

event.original.notes: Sensitive terminal/command payload source evidence retained in raw/hex form.

package.name.notes: SOFTWARE_UPDATE package identifier only; not full package inventory.

package.type.notes: Package type token such as rpm when present.

service.state.notes: Audit daemon lifecycle/configuration state helper mapping only.

ecs.notes: ECS mapping is partial and field-name guidance only.

pack_variants.label: audit.log one-record-per-line relay
pack_variants.description: Default initial variant for one complete Linux audit record per line, optionally syslog-wrapped by a collector relay.
known_limitations: Synthetic-equivalent fixtures only; no live Linux audit relay capture or Splunk read-back.
Multi-record audit correlation is preserved by audit_serial but not assembled in this version.

AppArmor-specific denial shapes, audit daemon abort/rotate/resume records, backlog/lost-event health, package-manager variants beyond the fixture-backed SOFTWARE_UPDATE row, and distro-specific wrapper fields remain future coverage.

cribl.notes: Use only after sampling the actual audit relay schema. Do not drop command arguments, PATH object context, login source, or audit serial by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: native syslog listener or relay-to-syslog path; preserve the pack sourcetype/source routing and validate listener framing locally. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: native syslog listener or relay-to-syslog path; preserve the pack sourcetype/source routing and validate listener framing locally. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.
